categories.main_business_segments: ASANUMA CORPORATION operates primarily in three business segments: building construction, civil engineering, and other businesses. The building and civil engineering segments encompass general contracting for construction and infrastructure projects, while the 'other' segment includes real estate-related activities, insurance agency services, waste management, and facility management (including PFI projects).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced construction and engineering technologies, including proprietary methods for steel structure rationalization, RC structure durability diagnostics, seismic retrofitting, and environmentally friendly renovation (ReQuality). It also invests in digital transformation (DX), such as AI-based inspection systems, BIM-based training, and the development of low-carbon and recycled materials, including eco-friendly concrete and ZEB (Zero Energy Building) technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ASANUMA serves a diverse customer base, including both public sector clients (government agencies) and private sector entities (corporations, manufacturers, logistics, and real estate developers). Its end markets span commercial, industrial, logistics, public infrastructure, and facility management, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, with a nationwide presence through regional branches. It also has a growing international footprint, particularly in Southeast Asia (notably Singapore and Thailand), and some activities in Oceania and Guam, mainly through subsidiaries and affiliates.
categories.supply_chain_position: ASANUMA operates as a downstream player in the supply chain, acting as a general contractor responsible for project management, construction, and delivery to end clients. It coordinates with upstream suppliers (materials, equipment) and subcontractors for project execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening domestic core businesses, expanding the renovation and renewal segment, advancing DX and productivity, enhancing governance and compliance, and contributing to environmental and social sustainability. R&D focuses on eco-friendly construction, carbon reduction, digitalization, and innovative renovation technologies, with clear targets for CO2 reduction and the adoption of Science Based Targets (SBT).
categories.revenue_model: The company primarily generates revenue through construction contract work (project-based sales), including both new builds and renovations, as well as facility management, real estate-related services, and PFI project operations. Revenue is recognized based on project progress and completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ASANUMA competes with major Japanese general contractors (such as Obayashi, Kajima, Shimizu, and Taisei) and faces competition from specialized construction and plant engineering firms domestically and internationally. It is positioned as a mid-sized, established general contractor with a strong reputation for quality and reliability, but is smaller than the largest industry players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥167.0 billion, with operating profit of ¥6.87 billion and net income attributable to parent shareholders of ¥4.69 billion. The company has shown steady revenue growth (9.4% YoY), maintains a workforce of around 1,800 employees, and targets further growth to ¥151 billion in sales and ¥6.4 billion in operating profit by FY2026 under its mid-term plan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ASANUMA emphasizes high-quality, reliable construction and engineering services, strong customer satisfaction, and a commitment to sustainability and safety. Its differentiation lies in proprietary renovation and diagnostic technologies, advanced DX initiatives, and a proactive approach to environmental challenges, including decarbonization and resource recycling, aiming to deliver added value to clients and society.
